marketing.android.lead: Install the Android app for hold-to-talk practice with Swathi, the same four-session Learn path, and a mobile-first speaking loop.
marketing.android.note: Closed-beta build for invited learners. Allow installs from unknown sources if Android asks.
marketing.android.title: Take speaking practice on your phone
marketing.benefit.hybrid.body: Practise with AI whenever you have a few minutes, then continue the same level with trainers. Guidance stays with you between classes.
marketing.benefit.hybrid.title: Hybrid AI + human courses
marketing.benefit.together.body: Most apps stop at the screen. Here you can practise with AI, join trainer-led sessions, and request 1:1 tuition when you want a person.
marketing.benefit.together.title: One path, two kinds of support
marketing.benefit.tuition.body: After you sign in, request a live speaking session with a trainer. Staff in your organisation review requests. There is no in-app payment or marketplace.
marketing.benefit.tuition.title: Request 1:1 tuition in the app
marketing.hero.lede: Listen to reviewed lesson audio, practise the pattern, then speak in a short exchange — with Kannada guidance. Type only if you ask to. A clear path on every level, not an endless AI chat.
marketing.hero.title: Let’s speak English fluently
marketing.join.body: Sign in below to continue. Your progress stays private to your organization.
marketing.join.title: Ready when you are
marketing.loop.improve.body: Try the same idea again. Marks follow published rules, not AI feeling.
marketing.loop.improve.title: Improve
marketing.loop.listen.body: Hear a reviewed English line before you speak.
marketing.loop.listen.title: Listen
marketing.loop.speak.body: Answer in a short turn. Hold to talk, or type instead if you need to.
marketing.loop.speak.title: Speak
marketing.loop.understand.body: Hear one clear English fix, with Kannada when it helps.
marketing.loop.understand.title: Understand
marketing.outcome.customer.body: Practise polite, clear answers for customer questions.
marketing.outcome.customer.title: Customer conversations
marketing.outcome.education.body: Follow class talk and explain your ideas in English.
marketing.outcome.education.title: Education
marketing.outcome.everyday.body: Use English in shops, travel and daily talk without freezing.
marketing.outcome.everyday.title: Everyday confidence
marketing.outcome.interview.body: Rehearse interview answers you can actually use.
marketing.outcome.interview.title: Interviews
marketing.outcome.work.body: Practise the English you need with colleagues and managers.
marketing.outcome.work.title: Work conversations
marketing.path.1.job: Understand the level idea from the governed lesson audio — not an AI-generated lecture.
marketing.path.1.output: Meaning check, notice the pattern, shadow and repeat, then one mini spoken answer before you leave.
marketing.path.1.title: Introduction
marketing.path.2.job: Rehearse the pattern with short listen-and-repeat activities.
marketing.path.2.output: Attempts, retries, and one priority correction at a time.
marketing.path.2.title: Practice
marketing.path.3.job: Use the pattern in a short exchange on this level’s topics. Listen to the Friend, then speak your reply. Type instead only if you ask to.
marketing.path.3.output: You listen to the Friend and speak in English. Type only on request. Natural English first, then one Kannada coaching point. Chat is not saved unless you choose.
marketing.path.3.title: Conversation
marketing.path.4.job: Freer, situational use — closer to real life.
marketing.path.4.output: Confidence and transfer beyond the script.
marketing.path.4.title: Interaction
marketing.pedagogy.1.body: You hear the exact commissioned clip. Kannada explanation is grounded in that audio and transcript, not invented on the fly.
marketing.pedagogy.1.title: Reviewed audio is the source of truth
marketing.pedagogy.2.body: Every level has Introduction, Practice, Conversation, and Interaction. You always know what to do next.
marketing.pedagogy.2.title: Four sessions, not one endless feed
marketing.pedagogy.3.body: Conversation is unscripted and topic-bounded — after you have understood and rehearsed the pattern.
marketing.pedagogy.3.title: Free exchange after practice, not instead of it
marketing.pedagogy.4.body: Mastery and unlocks follow published rules. AI coaches; it does not invent your score.
marketing.pedagogy.4.title: Marks from rules, not AI vibes
marketing.pedagogy.5.body: Progress stays in your tenant. Reviewed Kannada. No silent saving of chat into long-term memory.
marketing.pedagogy.5.title: Private to your organisation
marketing.plan.demo.lead: 5 days. Levels 1–2. Lesson practice speech included. No Role-play or free speech.
marketing.plan.demo.name: 5-day start

marketing.plan.modules.name: Premium features

marketing.plan.premium.name: Premium with Role-play
